class.name: HTMLRange
class.brief_description: A live range of nodes in an HTML layout.
class.description: Create a range with [method HTMLLayout.create_range] or [method HTMLLabel.create_range]. Endpoints use Godot character offsets for text and comments and logical child indices for other nodes. DOM edits update endpoints. Clearing or reparsing the layout invalidates the range.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the range still belongs to a live layout and its endpoints belong to that layout.

method.name: is_collapsed
method.description: Returns whether the range's endpoints are equal.

method.name: get_start_container
method.description: Returns the node containing the start boundary.

method.name: get_end_container
method.description: Returns the node containing the end boundary.

method.name: get_start_offset
method.description: Returns the start offset in its container.

method.name: get_end_offset
method.description: Returns the end offset in its container.

method.name: set_start
method.description: Sets the start boundary. If it follows the end or has a different tree root, both endpoints move to the new boundary.

method.name: set_end
method.description: Sets the end boundary. If it precedes the start or has a different tree root, both endpoints move to the new boundary.

method.name: collapse
method.description: Collapses the range to its end by default. Pass [code]true[/code] to collapse to the start.

method.name: select_node
method.description: Selects the node by setting the endpoints immediately before and after it in its parent.

method.name: select_node_contents
method.description: Selects the entire character data or all child nodes of the given node.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the DOM text within the range, excluding comments and generated content.

method.name: get_client_rects
method.description: Returns the visible text-selection rectangles in document coordinates from the last layout.

method.name: clone_contents
method.description: Returns a detached copy of the selected contents, preserving the shells of partially selected elements.

method.name: extract_contents
method.description: Moves the selected contents to a detached fragment and collapses the range. Fully selected nodes retain their handles.

method.name: delete_contents
method.description: Removes the selected contents and collapses the range.

method.name: insert_node
method.description: Inserts a same-layout node or fragment at the start. A text start container is split at its offset.

method.name: surround_contents
method.description: Moves the selected contents into the given element and selects that element. A partially selected non-text node rejects the operation.
